county_summary (or similar) created from county_raw with counts of rows, NAs in whp, and min and max of cell_area_km2
e object created by quantile() on county_raw$whp with probs c(0, .25, .50, .75, .90, .95, .99, 1) and na.rm = TRUE
county_cats created from county_raw with Category assigned by case_when() using edges e[...] and stored as an ordered factor in the specified risk order

prob_tbl created from county_cats with group_by(Category), summarize() area_km2 and n_cells, mutate() Probability = area_km2 / sum(area_km2), and select(Category, Probability, area_km2, n_cells) with probabilities summing approximately to 1
p_high_exact computed with plnorm() for a 10 km threshold using High Mean log and SD log with lower.tail = FALSE and value displayed
q95_high computed with qlnorm(p = 0.95, ...) using High Mean log and SD log and value displayed
d_3 and d_10 computed with dlnorm() at 3 km and 10 km using High Mean log and SD log and both values printed for comparison

High_Lognorm vector of length 450 generated with rlnorm() using High parameters and fixed seed, fast_growing_count computed as number of values >= 10, and histogram of High_Lognorm produced with clear axis labels
labels character vector created with all seven Category names from Table 1 in correct order and spelling
prob numeric vector created from Table 1 Probability column as proportions that sum to 1 and aligned with labels order
meanlog and sdlog numeric vectors created from Mean log and SD log columns in Table 1 and aligned with labels order and checked for matching lengths
Global constants N, S, and k set to specified number of ignitions per season, number of simulated seasons, and fast run threshold in km, with values shown
idx created using sample.int() or sample() of length N with replace = TRUE and prob = prob and table(labels[idx]) or similar used to show counts per category
d vector created with rlnorm(n = N, meanlog = meanlog[idx], sdlog = sdlog[idx]) and inspected with head() or summary()
fast_flags_one logical vector defined by d >= k and fast_count_one computed with sum(fast_flags_one) and optionally mean(fast_flags_one)
